items.text: Malik Nabers is active for Sunday Night Football vs. Cowboys, returning from ACL tear; decision left up to him after full practices and Q designation.
items.why: Full participant all week; self-decision post-warmup.
items.implication: Start with decoy/snap-count risk possible in return.
items.opportunity: Primary target for Jaxson Dart; elevated PS WRs reverse.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE for Cardinals; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as team wouldn't activate if worried about ankle.
items.why: Expected to play per reports; active confirmation.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside despite risk.
items.opportunity: Featured rookie role with Conner on IR.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (MCL sprain knee) not expected and officially inactive/OUT vs Lions despite full Friday practice; not quite ready.
items.why: Full participant late week but team cautious; expected Week 2.
items.implication: Clear path for Etienne lead role.
items.opportunity: Travis Etienne unchallenged carries/targets; Kendre Miller RB2.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early after huge first half (5-150-1); watching post-game injury status.
items.why: Aggravated prior hamstring; ruled out later in game.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest) left early; part of Sunday injury watch list after big hit.
items.why: Chest injury mid-game; no immediate return.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2; Chargers WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: Potential uptick for other LAC receivers if limited.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT with wrist injury; initial diagnosis fractured wrist, further MRI testing, out several weeks.
items.why: Wrist injury mid-game; fracture confirmed via sources.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; thins Ravens WR room with Flowers also hurt.
items.opportunity: More targets to Bateman/others; reverse prior elevation hype.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain: no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks; placed on IR.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; conservative timeline.
items.implication: Miss significant early season; NE WR room opens.
items.opportunity: Boosts other Patriots pass-catchers ROS short-term.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active vs Panthers after expected-to-play reports.
items.implication: Maintains WR role in high-powered Bears offense.
items.opportunity: Limits Burden/Loveland upside if full snaps.

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only Week 1 and returns Week 2 at Chargers; monitor feeling this week.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; optimistic short absence.
items.implication: Hold; potential quick return upgrades TE1 outlook.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer temporary TE1 boost if delayed.

items.text: Weekend status summary: Love/Odunze expected to play; Kamara not expected; Nabers no news yet (later active); Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful). Kamara absence impacts Etienne projections.
items.implication: Update projections accordingly; Etienne boost locked.
items.opportunity: Etienne clear lead back; Love/Odunze full roles.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way after strong showing.
items.why: Production and role in Ravens offense with WR injuries.
items.implication: Start/upgrade as TE1/ flex with Flowers/Lane out.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes in depleted WR room.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible despite Week 1 target questions.
items.why: Preseason belief in Bears TE role holds; Week 1 noise.
items.implication: Roster/trade target for upside in high-scoring offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets with Odunze active but volume available.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason hype with new OC; production validates.
items.why: Preseason talk + early usage in new scheme.

items.text: Main slate news locked; Nabers murky/up-to-him pre-active with PS elevations; combine injury wave Bowers/AJB/Darnold/Stribling + Sunday exits (Flowers/McConkey etc); no major proj changes else.
items.implication: Hold course on most; monitor returnees and exits for Week 2.
items.opportunity: Beneficiary adjustments for outs; Nabers start post-clear.
